AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
